ezekiel.48.p1.b1.text: Now these are the names of the tribes … Dan will have one portion …

ezekiel.48.p1.b2.text: This is the land you are to allot as an inheritance to the tribes of Israel, and these will be their portions … declares the Lord GOD.

ezekiel.48.p1.b3.text: It will be a special portion for them set apart from the land, a most holy portion … They must not sell or exchange any of it …

ezekiel.48.p1.b4.text: The workers of the city who cultivate it will come from all the tribes of Israel.

ezekiel.48.p2.b1.text: The gates of the city will be named after the tribes of Israel. … On the north side there will be three gates … On the east side … there will be three gates … On the south side … there will be three gates … on the west side … there will be three gates …

ezekiel.48.p2.b2.text: The perimeter of the city will be 18,000 cubits, and from that day on the name of the city will be: THE LORD IS THERE.”
